remediation.detail: Tool "transform_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Build an on-the-fly transform URL for a PixelVault image (resize, crop, format/quality, AI background removal, blur/sharpen/rotate/flip, brightness/contrast/saturation, and same-project watermark tiling). Provide exactly one of `url` (a PixelVault CDN URL) or `id` (an image id, resolved via the API " → after: "Build an on-the-fly transform URL for a PixelVault image (resize, crop, dpr, trim, anim=false, metadata, format/quality, AI background removal, blur/sharpen/rotate/flip, brightness/contrast/saturation, tiled or positioned same-project watermarks, text overlays, and built-in or custom named presets)."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
